Definition: adverb from (the feminine) of G3762; by no means:--not.
BiblicalUsage: By no means is how Matthew quotes the prophet about Bethlehem: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda, for out of thee shall come a Governor that shall rule my people Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bethlehem is the proof that God chooses the least: the town that was not the least among the princes of Judah gave the world its King.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
